name: Project List
description: Centered list of large project titles that tilt in 3D perspective; clicking one expands it to reveal an image with tag lines on both sides while the other titles recede.
contents: List of project titles with year
Expandable panel per project with image and left and right tag lines
behavior: Items fade in with a stagger on mount
Hovering a title shows animated bar indicators on both sides
Clicking a title expands it with clip-path image reveal and staggered tag lines
Neighbouring titles tilt back in 3D by distance from the open item
Clicking the open item or another item collapses and switches
List scrolls to keep the opened item centered
editableByProps: Projects, titles, years, images and tag lines
Background, text, indicator, tag and placeholder colors
Font files, title size, image aspect ratio and animation timing

needsCodeEdit.change: Adjust the 3D tilt depth of neighbouring titles

needsCodeEdit.where: gsap.fromTo call inside the start function

fixed: Registers custom GSAP eases for expand, collapse and text reveal
Loads the font through injected @font-face rules
Preloads all project images on mount
Fills the height of its parent with a minimum of one screen
